mapper.select: SELECT id FROM proj_project_template_revision WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND template_id=#{query.templateId} AND revision_no=#{query.revisionNo} AND status='PUBLISHED' AND deleted=b'0'
mapper.sql: SELECT * FROM proj_project_task WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND project_id=#{query.projectId} AND deleted=b'0' ORDER BY id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM proj_project_member_assignment WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND project_id=#{query.projectId} AND deleted=b'0' AND status='ACTIVE' AND member_role IN ('SERVICE_MANAGER_L1','SERVICE_MANAGER_L2') AND (assignment_type='PRIMARY' OR assignment_type IS NULL) AND (effective_from IS NULL OR effective_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ORDER BY user_id,id FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM acc_project_closure WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND project_id=#{query.projectId} AND deleted=b'0' ORDER BY submitted_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM acc_project_closure WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND process_instance_id=#{query.processInstanceId} AND deleted=b'0'

SELECT * FROM acc_closure_gate_snapshot WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND project_id=#{query.projectId} AND id=#{query.snapshotId} AND deleted=b'0'
SELECT * FROM acc_closure_review WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND project_id=#{query.projectId} AND application_id=#{query.applicationId} AND deleted=b'0' ORDER BY reviewed_at,id
mapper.update: UPDATE acc_project_closure SET status=#{query.status},decided_at=#{query.decidedAt},version=version+1, updater=#{query.updater},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND project_id=#{query.projectId} AND id=#{query.applicationId} AND version=#{query.expectedVersion} AND status='IN_REVIEW' AND deleted=b'0' AND #{query.status} IN ('APPROVED','REJECTED','CANCELLED')

UPDATE proj_project SET lifecycle_status='NORMAL_CLOSED',closure_type='NORMAL',closed_from_stage=#{query.fromStage}, closed_at=#{query.closedAt},version=version+1,updater=#{query.updater},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND id=#{query.projectId} AND version=#{query.expectedVersion} AND current_stage=#{query.fromStage} AND lifecycle_status='ACTIVE' AND deleted=b'0' AND closure_type IS NULL AND closed_at IS NULL AND closure_policy_snapshot IS NOT NULL
